source.title: Implementation guide for managers of Artificial intelligence systems
source.publisher: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
source.applicability: Managers of operational AI systems including public-facing and non-public-facing deployments, with concrete best practices for safety risk assessments, human oversight protocols, transparency measures, accountability frameworks, and monitoring of harmful outcomes in live environments

passages.locator: Best practices for human oversight & monitoring/list item
passages.text: Establish ongoing monitoring and evaluation procedures for deployed AI systems.
Provide free and accessible information to users about the nature and capabilities of AI systems, including information on how they are developed, operated and maintained.
